test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Yesterday, I __________ to be on a street with a few modest restaurants.
solution:
The correct answer is** __happened.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The above sentence is of **past simple tense.**
 
• The sentence formation for* *past simple tense is **the second form of the verb(happen - happened)** , which perfectly completes the above given sentence.
 
• **Hence option 1) happened is the answer.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
